constellations.name: ICEYE SAR constellation / Ukraine support
constellations.relation: ICEYE documents providing Ukraine's Ministry of Defence with expanded access to high-resolution SAR imagery for national-security decision support.
constellations.individual_asset_boundary: The agreement concerns constellation access. It does not establish that every publicly catalogued ICEYE spacecraft contributed to a specific operation.

constellations.name: ICEYE-X36 / Kosmos 2612 orbital comparison
constellations.relation: Public general-perturbations elements for ICEYE-X36 and COSMOS 2612 propagated to one common reference instant.
constellations.individual_asset_boundary: The plotted geometry is an estimate from public orbital elements, not live telemetry, tasking data, or evidence of current intent.
